before_conditions: The HypoVault contract has an initial supply of 1e6 and a +1 adjustment in fulfillDeposits, setting the initial asset-to-share ratio to 1e6.
The vault is on epoch 0 and the manager has not yet called fulfillDeposits for that epoch.
Alice has submitted a deposit request of 1e18 assets that is pending fulfillment.
The attacker holds underlying tokens and can transfer them to the vault contract before the manager's fulfillDeposits transaction is mined.
The accountant.computeNAV function includes the vault's underlying token balance in nav when skipUnderlying is false.
The fulfillDeposits function contains no check or validation on the resulting sharesReceived value.
required_property: When the manager fulfills a pending deposit, the depositor (Alice) should receive a fair, non-zero number of shares proportional to her deposited assets, and the asset-to-share ratio should not be manipulable by an outside party donating tokens to the vault before fulfillment.
bad_outcome: The attacker's donation inflates totalAssets and skews the asset-to-share ratio so that Alice's sharesReceived becomes zero (or severely reduced), causing her to lose her deposit and exposing subsequent deposit and withdraw operations to precision-loss-driven losses.
